name: cavemio-live-cursors
title: Live cursors
description: Other people’s cursors gliding over the same page: names that turn into speech bubbles, click ripples, and selections that follow them around.

cavemio.accessibility:
- People take the five chart colours in the order they first appear and keep them; pass color to choose your own.
- The cursors are decoration to assistive tech; what people say is announced through a polite status region, once per message.
- Positions are fractions, so the same numbers work on a phone and a wide screen as long as what’s underneath scales the same way.
- "/" is only taken while your pointer is over the area, so a page’s own "/" shortcut (search, usually) keeps working everywhere else.
- The loop sleeps when nobody is moving. With reduced motion cursors jump to where they are and bubbles change size in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: cursors
props.type: { id, name, x, y, color?, message?, clicks?, selection? }[]
props.description: – · Everyone else. x and y run from 0 to 1 across the area; raise clicks by one per click; selection is a box in the same units.

props.name: children
props.description: – · What they’re all looking at; the cursors float over it.

props.name: idleAfter
props.description: 8000 · Milliseconds without moving before a name folds into its dot.

props.name: onCursorMove
props.description: – · Your own mouse over the area in 0–1 units, or null when it leaves.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: – · Turns on "/" to say something at your pointer (mouse and trackpad only).

features.title: Smooth movement
features.description: Each cursor eases toward its latest position on a spring, in one frame loop that sleeps when nobody is moving.

features.title: Names that stay in view
features.description: Each cursor carries a name pill in its own colour, and the pill swings to the other side near the right or bottom edge.

features.title: Speech bubbles
features.description: When someone says something, their pill grows into a bubble around the words. Press / to say something at your own pointer.

features.title: Click ripples
features.description: A click sends a thin line ring out from the tip of the cursor.

features.title: Selections that follow
features.description: What someone is working on gets a 1px outline in their colour that glides to their next selection.

features.title: Any realtime channel
features.description: Positions are fractions from 0 to 1, so they work on a phone and a wide screen. Pass everyone else’s in whatever rate the channel manages.

states.title: move
states.description: A spring (stiffness 150, damping 24) per cursor, run in one requestAnimationFrame loop that writes transforms directly and stops once everyone has settled. Someone new appears where they are.

states.title: say
states.description: The name pill eases its width and height (360ms) to hold the message, which blurs in (300ms); clearing it folds the bubble back to the pill.

states.title: click
states.description: A 36px thin line ring in their colour scales from 0.3 to 1 and fades (620ms).

states.title: select
states.description: A 1px outline with a name tag; its box eases to the next selection (420ms) and fades when cleared.

states.title: idle / leave
states.description: After idleAfter without moving, the name folds into its dot and the cursor dims to 55%. Someone who leaves shrinks and fades (260ms).

states.title: you
states.description: With onMessage, "/" opens a bubble at your pointer that follows it; Enter sends, Escape or clicking away closes. What you sent stays for 4 seconds.
